subject.title: [Bug]: Codex runtime collapses automatic WhatsApp reply blocks into one bubble

question: Should newline-mode automatic replies treat blank-line paragraph boundaries as mandatory outbound-message boundaries across all runtimes and channels, even when adjacent paragraphs fit within the transport limit?
rationale: Current behavior was intentionally introduced as shared packing, while the requested change deliberately reverses that rule for delivery semantics; source-level repair alone cannot choose the product contract.

options.title: Keep packing as the newline contract
options.body: Retain the current shared behavior and close the active implementation proposal as an intentional channel-efficiency choice.

options.title: Adopt preserve-paragraph delivery
options.body: Land a shared planner-level rule with focused regression coverage for fresh and existing newline-mode setups across relevant delivery paths.

recommendation.title: Adopt preserve-paragraph delivery
recommendation.body: Land a shared planner-level rule with focused regression coverage for fresh and existing newline-mode setups across relevant delivery paths.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the currently merged shared packing behavior and is the strongest history-based routing candidate for deciding whether to reverse that contract.
